linkedin.title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling as long as possible.
linkedin.body:
We decided to build the opposite. At Headlinne, our philosophy is simple. We want to help you get informed, not addicted. The modern news cycle is designed to manufacture anxiety, but we believe you can stay up to date without feeling overwhelmed.

We use AI to strip away the noise. Instead of pushing the most sensational headlines that trigger an emotional reaction, our technology focuses on clarity and context. It learns what you actually care about and filters out the clutter that doesn't matter to your day.

True personalization isn't about feeding you more of the same. It is about respecting your time. When you open an app, you should find what you need quickly and then get back to your life. That is the standard we are setting for ourselves.

story_card.headline: IMF warns of potential AI economic bubble
story_card.standfirst: The global financial watchdog says AI hype could lead to a damaging market correction.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The IMF warned that the current AI investment bubble could burst and hurt the global economy.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Massive spending on AI technology has created financial instability and mounting debt concerns.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: A sudden drop in AI market value could rattle global financial stability beyond just tech.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Experts are also tracking how rising cyberattack risks could further complicate this situation.

story_card.caption:
The International Monetary Fund is warning that the AI bubble might pose a threat to the global economy.

Financial watchdogs are concerned that heavy investment in AI is creating an unstable market environment. Beyond the debt risks, they note that cyberattacks are adding significant pressure to the sector.
